name: Crater Lake: Cleetwood Cove, Watchman Peak and Mount Scott
blurb: Three rim hikes around the deepest lake in the US: the Watchman lookout above Wizard Island, the steep Cleetwood Cove Trail down to the water, and Mount Scott, the park's highest peak.
status: partly closed: Cleetwood Cove Trail (the only lake access) is closed for the 2026, 2027 and 2028 seasons for rehabilitation, with no boat tours; Rim Drive, the North Entrance Road and the road to Rim Village are closed for winter since November 1; Watchman and Mount Scott trails are snow-covered and unreachable by car until Rim Drive reopens (usually July).
rare: Red fox: Crater Lake's high-country red foxes are a montane population presumed to be Sierra Nevada red foxes, one of the rarest mammals in North America; park cameras first detected one here in 2011 and the park has studied them since. (https://www.biologicaldiversity.org/news/press_releases/2012/red-fox-06-19-2012.html)
